title: Pipeline Build Order
summary: Order data pipeline tables so every table builds after its upstream dependencies.

stages.title: Deterministic build order
stages.requirement:
Our warehouse has `tables` (unique names) and dependencies `(upstream, downstream)`: the
upstream table must be built before the downstream one. Write `build_order(tables, deps)`
returning a list containing every table exactly once, so that each dependency's upstream
comes before its downstream.

Many orders can be valid, so make it deterministic: whenever several tables are ready,
build the **alphabetically smallest** next. If the dependencies contain a cycle, raise
`ValueError`. Every name in `deps` appears in `tables`. Duplicate dependency pairs may occur.

```python
build_order(["orders", "users", "revenue", "raw"],
            [("raw", "orders"), ("raw", "users"), ("orders", "revenue"), ("users", "revenue")])
# -> ["raw", "orders", "users", "revenue"]
```

def test_example():
    tables = ["orders", "users", "revenue", "raw"]
    deps = [("raw", "orders"), ("raw", "users"), ("orders", "revenue"), ("users", "revenue")]
    assert build_order(tables, deps) == ["raw", "orders", "users", "revenue"]

def test_large_chain():
    names = [f"t{i:05d}" for i in range(20_000)]
    deps = [(names[i], names[i + 1]) for i in range(len(names) - 1)]
    assert build_order(list(reversed(names)), deps) == names

hints: Count how many unbuilt upstream tables each table still waits on (its in-degree).
Kahn's algorithm: start with tables of in-degree 0. When you build one, decrement its downstream tables. Any that reach 0 become ready.
Use a min-heap for the ready set so the alphabetically smallest is built next. If you build fewer than all tables, there's a cycle.

solution.explanation:
Kahn's algorithm with a min-heap for the ready set gives the lexicographically smallest
valid order. Deduplicating edges with `set(deps)` keeps the in-degrees correct. A cycle
(including a self-loop) leaves some tables with positive in-degree forever, so fewer than
`len(tables)` get built, and that's the signal to raise.
